hypotheses.claim: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 at 500 ms, replacing the fixed worst-removal-style ruin priority with a stagnation-adaptive rank-power score that anneals its exponent from greedy (p high) toward diversification (p low) and softens the route-load gate under stagnation will lower mean tour length below the current 16.0597 baseline, with gains concentrated in the exhausted regimes (size=100, tight capacity, eccentric depot, uniform spatial/demand), by escaping R2R stagnation cycles while preserving destructive pressure on high-savings nodes.

next_search_advice.direction: Stagnation-adaptive multiplicative-gate rank-power ruin scoring: score_i = rank_power(|removal_savings_i|/scale * gate_load^a * gate_depot^b * gate_demand^c * gate_rdist^d, p(iter_frac, stagnation_ratio)) where the rank exponent p sweeps from ~1.2 (early, greedy worst-removal) to ~0.4 (late/stagnant, near-uniform mixed removal), and the load gate is softened (smaller exponent) as stagnation rises to avoid repeatedly pulling from the same over-loaded route; tuned to the exhausted regimes size=100, tight capacity, eccentric depot, uniform spatial/demand.
